name: Cypress Hill
notes: LA's psychedelic outlier, and the parameter that actually makes it is register separation, not tempo: the research says "extreme register separation — sub low, thin sample mid-high, nothing in between", so the bass tops out at 39 and the melody starts at 69, leaving a deliberate hole where every other entry in this batch puts a keyboard. The drums are mixed "to feel dragging rather than snappy", which is `swing` 0.58 with `quantizeStrength` down at 0.78 and the slowest kick here; hats are sparse and allowed to stop. The harmony is a pitched-and-looped blues guitar figure rather than played chords, so `impliedByRiff` is set, `halfStepDissonance` is the highest in this batch at 0.20 ("deliberately spooky", odd loops) and the voicing register is the widest — 40 to 74 — because a collaged sample is not a close triad. ⚠ `medium`, and the research says exactly why: high on vocal and production character, medium on tempo specifics. The INFERRED parameters are the tempo centre (88–98 is a band, not a documented figure) and the i–VII family, which exists so the chord part reaches its distinctness floor over a harmony the research calls a loop. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 855 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
